description:
Vechnoslavsk is a land of dense forests and swamps. While of interest to any biologist, this allod is largely impassable.  The existing settlements are located on the coast itself, but the depths of the allod are impenetrable swamps full of monstrous mosquitoes.

The swamps are covered with coniferous forests, and the climate can be described as moderately cool. The fauna is represented by numerous invertebrates, amphibians and reptiles, and animals are represented only by saber-toothed squirrels, bats, and martens. At least this is what we managed to find. More detailed research requires better preparation.

description:
Igsh is a metropolitan allod geographically divided into two parts - steppe and desert.  The desert is the bottom of an ancient sea which was exposed after the world split into allods. Steppe is the part of those lands that occupied the entire eastern outskirts of Yul.

Their flora and fauna are quite typical for these territories. However, it should be noted that due to the increasing urbanization, they are significantly degrading. Igsh rhinos and unicorns used for commercial hunting are becoming rare species.

Another threat to the animals is the Necro-Incubator. Its creations wander around the steppes and destroy everything they can reach.

The only prosperous community on Igsh are termites which have grown in numbers in recent years. This tendency is only a part of the general changes of this kind that occur throughout Sarnaut. It appears to be connected with the influence of the astral plane.

Izune is an Orc allod which became part of the Empire after the annexation of the Orcs. A typical example of the steppe allods formed when the eastern part of the continent split apart.  The only difference is the old volcano in the very center of the allod where a dragon once dwelled.

The approaches to the volcano are overgrown with forest, but the rest are bare steppes. Izune is quite poor in resources. The population growth has a damaging effect on the flora and fauna.

In recent years, the allod has seen the increasing numbers of the Draconids who are likely to start competing for the remaining resources with the Orcs.

expansion: Long believed lost (in fact it had been hidden by magic). In the 14.0 storyline, while searching for a way to save the Great Trees that had begun dying all across Sarnaut, we reach it from Howlem.

description:
Istinsk is one of the recently settled allods. It is a typical allod with steady frosty weather, rich in meteorite and other ore deposits.

Despite the harsh conditions, it has a fairly diverse fauna consisting of typical inhabitants of coniferous forests. Additionally, there is a lake full of commercial fish species in the center of the allod.

However, the mining of ore in the mountains and quarries poses a certain danger to the biodiversity of this allod.

expansion:
The House de Desirae has won several times; its present success is owed to Prince Dakkar, the son of our king. It was Prince Dakkar who restored the prestige of necromancy among the Elves, which led the Conclave to lift the last bans on practising it. After that Ball, however, unpleasant events followed: the House de Doucer, or rather its Head, Armando, acted with extraordinary baseness and brought about the death of the prince's bride, a flagrant violation of the rules of the Great Game. Louis de Desirae seized on this to declare the House de Doucer outlaw and confiscated its home allod, Nocturn.
So the House de Desirae now owns two allods: little Tenebra and vast Nocturn.

description:
Xadagan is a sad example of a consumer attitude towards nature. Once it was similar in everything to Suslanger: there were oases and a unique desert fauna in its territory.

Now this allod has become a construction site, all water resources have been utilized, and the desert is now covered in quarries and buildings under construction. According to Nefer Ur's plan, the entire allod will eventually be turned into a huge metal city.

If another life once existed there, it has been destroyed.

description:
Manodar is a unique jewel among the allods of the Empire. Discovered at the end of Nezeb's reign, this allod became the granary of the Empire. With its rich black soil and warm, settled weather, the allod capable of producing more than four harvests per year.

Surprisingly, before the start of resettlement, its green plains were rather sparsely populated. The only native inhabitants of the allod are the Waterfolk living in the rivers.

However, there are threats even here - the allod is at a rare intersection of astral currents, which is why it is profitable to build mana stations there.  But the influence of mana stations on nature is still poorly understood.

expansion: The island was built from concepts by a player known as Merani. The Servant of Light on the allod is a nod to her.

description:
New Igsh, an allod discovered in the last century, is named that for a reason.  It is very similar to the old Igsh as it's almost an exact copy of it, but there is no Dead Sea here.

The whole allod is covered in endless steppes. It's possible that Igsh and New Igsh were likely part of a single biocenosis, since even their fauna and flora are absolutely identical.

Except New Igsh is much less populated. So it can be an example of what the capital allod was like before Nezebgrad absorbed most of it.

description:
Suslanger is a unique case. It's all about the recent events.

Without a doubt, we are dealing with something unknown.

This "Ambrosia", as someone called it, is something incredible. We are dealing with a form of life that encompasses both animal and plant life. Moreover, it seems that the Ambrosia exists in a form that was not previously considered living - minerals.

We have never had anything like it. Neither the Blight I studied nor the modifiers come anywhere close. I am not inclined to pathos, but I am willing to swear that this is the real concentrated essence of Life itself. It would be nice to understand where it came from...

description:
Yakhch is a unique land in the sense that it's the only allod that has changed a lot over the years. It was once a typical desert allod, but then the Great Tree was planted there.

It changed the desert - it sucked out excess salt, consolidated the sands, and raised the water level. Mixed forests began to grow on the allod, and a different fauna appeared.

Now it's more of a typical allod from the middle latitudes than the hot desert of the south.
